name: Giving soul
description: a damned soul of the Ember Wastes, stuck in Hell's loop forever: a thin hunched bald human figure in a long ragged ash-grey shroud, pale ash-grey skin, hollow tired eyes, a soft pale blue-white glow around its outline, bare feet, arms held out stiffly in front, one small dark stone offered on its open palm, eyes averted

poses.stand: standing hunched, arms held out stiffly in front
poses.react: arms out, the small dark stone offered on an open palm

idle.action: rocks gently in place, breathing slowly

react.action: holds out the stone, flinches, pulls it back an inch, offers it again
